"'''Old Silver Eyes'''" was the nickname given to a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as the ninth [[Administrator/Legends|administrator]] of [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]]. He took control of the Wheel following the disappearance of the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Master-Com]], his predecessor, and ran it successfully for three years before [[Death/Legends|dying]] in his sleep. The Wheel fell into the hands of the [[Biituian]] [[Dov Paploush]] following "Old Silver Eyes" death. During his time as administrator "Old Silver Eyes" was incredibly popular with the station's clientèle.

==Biography==
The man known as "Old Silver Eyes" became the ninth administrator of [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] late in his life, following the disappearance of the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Master-Com]], who served as the eighth administrator of the Wheel for ninety-seven [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before vanishing. After the droid vanished, the station was without an administrator for several [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] during which time the station's facilities deactivated. Then overnight the station suddenly lit up again and its services returned to normal, only with "Old Silver Eyes" now running the show. No one on the Wheel knew where the new administrator had come from, but he ran the station as successfully as his predecessor had, and with the same popularity amongst its guests. After three years of running the Wheel, in which the station's profits peaked, the man died peacefully in his sleep. Soon after his [[Death/Legends|death]], the Wheel was purchased by the [[Biituian]] [[Dov Paploush]], whom discovered that the Wheel's [[Master Communication system]] had been unplugged and replaced it with more modern technology.<ref name="VSV" />

==Personality and traits==
"Old Silver Eyes" was a charismatic [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who whilst working as administrator of the Wheel was known to radiate a captivating classical quality. The enigmatic administrator was as genial as his incredibly popular droid predecessor, if not more so, and just as proficient at the job, with some claiming he worked with almost super-human efficiency. To many of those who worked with "Old Silver Eyes" it felt as if Master-Com had never left, although if questioned on the droid's disappearance, the Human would only turn up his hands and smile. During the three years he served as the administrator of the Wheel its patrons, and perhaps the station itself, pulsed with elation. "Old Silver Eyes" had [[Color/Legends|gray]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and a moustache by the time he came to run the Wheel as well as silver colored [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="VSV" />

==Behind the scenes==
"Old Silver Eyes" was first mentioned in the second entry of ''[[Viva Space Vegas! The History of the Marvelous Wheel]]'', a pair of articles released on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|blog]] in [[2013]] and written by [[Abel G. Peña]] and [[Rich Handley]]. The entry describes his eyes as ocular receptors when detailing his death, possibly hinting at some form of connection to his droid predecessor.
